video.title: AI欧腐《被宿敌标记/Marked by My Sworn Enemy》
video.desc:
At his sister’s engagement, fox heir Lucien, 17, falls into a pool wearing a fate brooch. His childhood friend and rival, wolf prince Damian, dives in to save him—but Lucien wakes ten years later, married to King Damian and father to Theo. Branded a wastrel obsessed with musician Rowan, he must break a Dark Melody Curse and reclaim his stolen life.
姐姐的订婚宴上，十七岁的狐族继承人 Lucien 戴着一枚命运胸针落入水池。他的发小兼死对头、狼族王子 Damian 跳下去救他——可 Lucien 再睁眼，已是十年之后：他成了狼王 Damian 的伴侣，还是 Theo 的父亲。此时的他被人视为一个只知道迷恋乐师 Rowan 的败家子。他必须破解"暗曲诅咒"，夺回被偷走的人生。
